Unified Unity MCP Skills

Active agent rules now live in the repository root AGENTS.md. Active skills live in skills/. The hidden .agent and .gemini folders are reserved for client configuration only.

Core Workflow

  • Read AGENTS.md before code or documentation changes.
  • Use relevant skills/<name>/SKILL.md files as task workflow guides.
  • Check active_tools.json or ToolsCatalog.md before calling MCP tools.
  • Keep Unity C# simple, direct, and readable.
  • Do not use switch in repository code examples or implementation.

Core Skills

unified-unity-mcp

Use and maintain the Unity MCP server, tool catalog, and tool workflows.

csharp-code-style

Apply the repository C# style and method-shape rules.

unity-csharp-fundamentals

Write safe Unity component, ScriptableObject, and Editor code.

unity-developer

Implement Unity MCP package features in the existing architecture.

unity-testrunner

Run and interpret Unity Test Framework checks.

Focused Skills

csharp-xml-docs

unity-ui

skill-creator

Create and maintain concise skills that match this repository.
